sharedCause: Inverting a transformed scene enclosure inflates parameter bounds. Mapping before parameter rounding changes the enclosing opacity allocation. Separately, an affine filter must prepare source capture relative to the allocated destination bitmap, whose origin survives later clips.
sharedModel: ParameterVisualBounds accompanies ParameterObjectBounds through nested sources, preserving strokes separately. Opacity enclosures use graph Output; viewport coverage uses StoredImage. The actual isolated destination supplies the affine capture origin; mask/clip replay has an independent grid. Existing rounding, sampling and packed alpha arithmetic remain unchanged.
